Voter Information

Early In-Person Voting

In November 2022, Michigan voters overwhelmingly approved a constitutional amendment that gives voters the right to vote early and in-person.

During the early voting period, voters are issued a ballot and can then insert their ballot directly into a tabulator at their early voting site.

Early Voting will run from Saturday, October 24, 2026 to Sunday, November 1, 2026 during the hours shown below. Please see the chart for a complete list of Early Voting site locations.

Monday8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.
Tuesday8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.
Wednesday8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.
Thursday12:00 p.m. - 8:00 p.m.
Friday8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.
Saturday8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.
Sunday8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.

If you are a registered voter in one of the Cities/Townships listed below, you may vote at the assigned Regional Site or the Central Site.
